title: Explainability & Interpretability — Compare with a Simpler Local Story
key_insight: Local surrogate methods fit a simpler model around one prediction. Feature attribution methods divide a prediction difference among inputs.
body:
## Compare with a Simpler Local Story

A complex predictor curves across the whole dataset, but near one case a small approximation can show which changes matter most.

Local surrogate methods fit a simpler model around one prediction. Feature attribution methods divide a prediction difference among inputs.

Results depend on the baseline and neighborhood chosen. State those choices when presenting an explanation.
common_mistakes: A colorful heatmap is always faithful.
One local explanation describes all global behavior.
Explainability removes the need for appeals.
mini_exercise: Draw “Compare with a Simpler Local Story” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Explanations can help people inspect model behavior, but they must be tested rather than mistaken for proof.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Compare with a Simpler Local Story” to explain Explainability & Interpretability plainly.
